THE UNIT MOUNTED CHILLER CONTROLS SHALL MODULATE THE CHILLER CAPACITY TO MAINTAIN 44 DEG F CHILLED WATER
HEATING WATER SYSTEM SEQUENCE OF OPERATION
THE HEATING WATER SYSTEM SHALL BE CONTROLLED BY A DIRECT DIGITAL PLANT CONTROLLER CONNECTED TO THE BAS.
THE EXHAUST FAN SHALL OPERATE BASED UPON THE BUILDING OCCUPIED SCHEDULE
AS PROVIDED BY THE OWNER. WHEN SCHEDULED ON, THE EXHAUST FAN SHALL BE ENERGIZED.
